description: This is a host running an sge_execd.

attributes.name: name
description: Unique name of the execution host.
This name must be resolvable on all hosts dealing with it
(master host, the execution host itself, interactive and tightly integrated parallel jobs contacting it)

attributes.name: scaling_list
attributes.summary: instructions for scaling of host load values
description: Used to scale host load values.
Contains pairs of load value names and doubles.

attributes.name: consumable_config_list
description: consumable resources of host

attributes.name: usage_scaling_list
description: defines scaling of job usage values reported by this execution host

attributes.name: load_list
description: list of load values (e.g. load_avg) reported by the execution host

attributes.name: lt_heard_from
description: timestamp when the sge_execd on the host last communicated with sge_qmaster

attributes.name: processors
description: number of processors of the execution host
actually the number of processor cores (@todo threads?)

attributes.name: acl
description: userset defining who can access the host

attributes.name: xacl
description: userset defining who can not access the host

attributes.name: prj
description: project list defining which jobs of which projects can run on the host

attributes.name: xprj
description: project list defining jobs of which projects can run not on the host

attributes.name: sort_value
description: sort value which is only used in the scheduler thread

attributes.name: tagged
description: used in scheduler to tag hosts

attributes.name: load_correction_factor
description: Artificial load added for jobs that have just started, decaying over `load_adjustment_decay_time`. Stops the scheduler overloading a host by dispatching to it faster than the reported load can rise.

attributes.name: seq_no
description: suitability of this host for a job, scheduler only

attributes.name: sge_load
description: calculated from load values, scheduler only

attributes.name: sge_ticket_pct
description: percentage of total SGEEE tickets, scheduler only

attributes.name: sge_load_pct
description: percentage of total SGEEE tickets, scheduler only

attributes.name: load_report_interval
description: used for caching from global/local configuration

attributes.name: resource_utilization
description: contains per consumable information about resource utilization for this host

attributes.name: cached_complexes
description: used in scheduler for caching built attributes

attributes.name: cache_version
description: used to decide whether QU_cached_complexes needs a refresh

attributes.name: reschedule_unknown
description: used for caching from global/local conf; timout after which jobs will be rescheduled automatically

attributes.name: reschedule_unknown_list
description: after the rundown of reschedule_unknown this list contains all jobs which will be rescheduled automatically

attributes.name: report_seqno
attributes.summary: sequence number of the last report
description: sequence number of the last report (job/load/..) qmaster received from the execd.
This seqno is used to detect old * reports, because reports are send * asynchronously
and we have no guarantee that they arrive in order at qmaster

attributes.name: report_variables
description: @todo add description

attributes.name: merged_report_variables
description: list of variables written to the report file, merged from global host and actual host

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.

attributes.name: internal_topology
description: topology string stored internally, used by qmaster
contains hardware information (socket, cores, threads),
memory information (numa nodes and caches),
and attributes for those nodes (size, speed etc.)

attributes.name: auto_added_time
attributes.summary: time at which the host added itself to the cluster
description: The time at which the host added itself to the cluster, when its execution
daemon registered and a rule of the qmaster_params AUTO_ADD_HOSTS matched it.
0 for a host which an administrator added.
